SELECT	SOURCE_FLAG, NCR_HEADER_ID, NCR_SERIAL, NCR_TYPE, BUSINESS_UNIT_SHRT,
		BEST_SITE_ACRO, SITE_SHRT, NCR_QUANTITY, PART_NUMBER, PART_DESCRIPTION,
		PART_SERIAL_NUMBER, BEST_CODE, SYSTEM_SUPPLIER_CODE, NCR_WRITTEN_DATE,
		NCR_CLOSED_DATE, PO_NUMBER, PO_LINE_ITEM, LOT_CODE, ON_SITE_HOURS,
		OFF_SITE_HOURS, PVR_DISPLAY_IDENT, PVR_STATUS, PLANNED_SHIP_DATE,
		BOEING_REP_BEMSID, BFE_CUSTOMER, EFFECTIVITY, AIRCRAFT_LINE_NUMBER,
		PV_BFAI_DISPLAY_IDENT, PROGRAM_SHRT, QUANTITY_VERIFIED, QUANTITY_ACCEPTED,
		PV_ACTIVITY_TYPE_SHRT, PV_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE_SHRT, PV_ACTIVITY_SUB_TYPE_SRI,
		RESPONSIBILITY, CA_DOCUMENT_QUEUE_STATUS_CODE, CA_DOCUMENT_QUEUE_STATUS_LONG,
LASTUPDATEDATE, QUANTITY_FIXED_WHILE_WAITING, QUANTITY_TOTAL_DEFECTIVE
